rationale: The stock gapped up ~9.25% on positive Phase 3 trial news but has since faded significantly from the session high of $38.49 to $36.56, sitting at only 18.2% of today's range and trading below both VWAP ($36.93) and the 9-EMA ($36.83). The last five 1-minute candles show a consistent drift lower with increasing volume on the most recent down move, suggesting continued selling pressure from gap-day profit-taking. With no clear support level established and the price in a downtrend within the session, neither a long (against the intraday trend) nor a short (against a strong fundamental catalyst with 4.97x relative volume) offers a compelling risk/reward setup at this moment.
